summary: CIBC filed a Rule 424(b)(5) product supplement (No. EQUITY MLI-1) covering future issuances of senior unsecured notes linked to equity indices, ETFs, stocks or baskets, under an existing June 2026 shelf. No specific deal is priced: terms, Market Measure, maturity and any coupons or call features will appear in later pricing supplements, with units typically $10 principal. BofA Securities and affiliates act as agents in a principal capacity. Notes are unsecured bank obligations, not deposit-insured and generally unlisted. Watch for subsequent term sheets pricing actual tranches and any market-measure or credit-spread developments.
